// Part: room: Smokehouse smoke room (plan.md ROOMS: S5 smoke room, box 62,1,13 .. 64,4,15).
// Dim smoky crib: a lit smoker against the back wall at x63 z15 (its flue is the back-wall hole at x63 y2), barrel hams
// hung on iron chains from two spruce tie beams (x62 and x64, along z) at the outer columns, open trapdoor racks on the
// side walls between the hams, and one hanging lantern from a beam cross-piece at x63 z13. The x63 column stays clear
// from the door (x63 z12) to the smoker. Inner air only; the shell, chimney and roof belong to other parts.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

// Origin: the box's lowest corner (x 62, y 1, z 13). Rows run along +x, successive rows along +z (z 13, 14, 15).
const ORIGIN = [62, 1, 13];

const LEGEND = {
  B: ["barrel", { facing: "down" }],
  C: ["iron_chain", { axis: "y" }],
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
  S: ["smoker", { facing: "north", lit: "true" }],
  W: ["stripped_spruce_log", { axis: "z" }],
  X: ["stripped_spruce_log", { axis: "x" }],
  R: ["spruce_trapdoor", { facing: "east", half: "bottom", open: "true" }],
  Q: ["spruce_trapdoor", { facing: "west", half: "bottom", open: "true" }],
};

// One entry per layer y 1..4, each three rows (z 13..15) of three cells (x 62..64).
const LAYERS = [
  // y 1: floor. The smoker sits against the back wall (z 16), the door is in the z 12 wall.
  ["...", "...", ".S."],
  // y 2: hams (barrels hung face down) on the outer columns, trapdoor racks flush on the side walls at z 14.
  ["B.B", "R.Q", "B.B"],
  // y 3: chains from the tie beams; the lantern hangs from the cross-piece at x63 z13.
  ["CLC", "...", "C.C"],
  // y 4: tie beams along z at x 62 and x 64; cross-piece along x at x 63 z 13 for the lantern.
  ["WXW", "W.W", "W.W"],
];

export function build(g) {
  layers(g, ORIGIN, LEGEND, LAYERS);
}
